name: My smeyalis i plakali
source:
"We cried, but deep down we laughed like children, realizing that life is just beginning, and this is the start of one great story, lasting a lifetime..."

This is a short story about Alisa, who has lost her way in a vile and unfair life. It is about how important it is sometimes to accept the things that happen to you, and how important it is to just let them go. About how you can survive loneliness and despair and get what you truly deserve. About how death is just death, and it does not offer redemption or solve your problems. About how it is okay to cry, and how pancakes with sugar and butter are really delicious.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927718677]Steam[/url]]
